editorial.intro: Explore Tupolev aircraft clipart with Tu 134 and Tu 154 airliners, Tu 144 supersonic jets and Tu 95 turboprop illustrations.
paragraphs: Start with the pointed nose and broad delta wing of the Tu 144, then look for the three rear engines of the Tu 154. This Tupolev aircraft clipart gallery also includes Tu 134 airliners with glazed noses and Tu 95 aircraft with prominent propellers.

Among the {{artworkCount}} illustrations are color profiles, banking views, black and white outlines and airport scenes. Pair a Tu 144 with a Tu 154 for an aviation history worksheet, or choose an apron scene for a personal flight scrapbook.

editorial.intro: Explore Saab aircraft clipart with Draken, Viggen and Gripen fighters, Safir trainers and Saab 340 turboprops.
paragraphs: Double delta wings give the Draken its distinctive shape, while the Saab 340 has two propellers and a row of passenger windows. This Saab aircraft clipart collection includes both, as well as Viggen and Gripen fighters and Safir trainers.

Look through {{artworkCount}} illustrations for a Swedish aviation timeline or an aircraft silhouette lesson. Overhead views make the wing shapes easy to compare, and color profiles work well as individual labels.

editorial.intro: Explore Tupolev aircraft clipart with Tu 134 and Tu 154 airliners, Tu 144 supersonic jets and Tu 95 turboprop illustrations.
paragraphs: Start with the pointed nose and broad delta wing of the Tu 144, then look for the three rear engines of the Tu 154. This Tupolev aircraft clipart gallery also includes Tu 134 airliners with glazed noses and Tu 95 aircraft with prominent propellers.

Among the {{artworkCount}} illustrations are color profiles, banking views, black and white outlines and airport scenes. Pair a Tu 144 with a Tu 154 for an aviation history worksheet, or choose an apron scene for a personal flight scrapbook.
